title: Snoozing Actually Makes You More Tired
hook: Hitting the snooze button makes you more tired, not less.

narration.text: Hitting the snooze button makes you more tired, not less.
Your body has a natural sleep cycle, moving between light and deep stages.
When your alarm first goes off, you might be in a lighter sleep stage.
Pressing snooze lets you drift back into a deeper sleep state.
Waking from deep sleep causes 'sleep inertia', that groggy feeling.
Each snooze button press restarts this cycle, making inertia worse.
It leaves you feeling more fatigued and disoriented all day.
Do you find yourself hitting snooze multiple times each morning?

description: Ever wonder why you feel more exhausted after hitting snooze a few times? It's not just in your head. Your body's sleep cycles are to blame, creating 'sleep inertia' that makes you feel groggier.
topic: Why you feel more tired after pressing the snooze button multiple times.
